title: RTLReviewBench: LLM Hardware Reviewers Rarely Miss Bugs but Routinely Reject Correct RTL
abstract: arXiv:2611.21678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hardware teams increasingly ask large language models (LLMs) to review register-transfer level (RTL) code, yet it is unclear whether a model can tell a correct module from a buggy one without simulating it. We introduce RTLReviewBench, a benchmark of 114 matched pairs of buggy and correct Verilog modules. Each pair shares one specification, most buggy modules are real failures of LLM code generators, and every label is confirmed by simulation. Evaluating 12 commercial and open-weight models, we find a consistent asymmetry: reviewers rarely accept buggy code but often reject correct code, producing more than five false rejections for every missed bug. Synthetic mutants hide part of the problem: on the same designs, models miss far fewer injected bugs than real ones. translated_title: RTLReviewBench：LLM硬件审查者很少漏掉Bug，但经常拒绝正确的RTL
translated_abstract: 硬件团队越来越多地要求大型语言模型（LLM）来审查寄存器传输级（RTL）代码，然而目前尚不清楚模型是否能够在不进行仿真的情况下区分正确的模块与有缺陷的模块。我们推出了RTLReviewBench，这是一个包含114对匹配的有缺陷与正确Verilog模块的基准测试。每一对模块共享同一份规范，大多数有缺陷的模块是LLM代码生成器的真实失败案例，且每个标签均通过仿真得到确认。在对12个商业和开源权重模型进行评估后，我们发现了一个持续存在的不对称性：审查者很少接受有缺陷的代码，但经常拒绝正确的代码，每漏掉一个bug就会对应超过五个错误的拒绝。合成的变异体掩盖了部分问题：在相同的设计上，模型漏掉的注入bug远少于真实bug。要求模型在做出判断之前先进行推理，能显著减少较弱审查者的错误拒绝，并且一项受控消融实验表明，推理出现的位置……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RTLReviewBench基准，包含114对经仿真验证的有缺陷与正确Verilog模块配对，揭示了LLM审查RTL代码时的不对称现象——很少放过真实bug却频繁错误拒绝正确代码，且合成变异体无法完全暴露这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RTLReviewBench, a benchmark of 114 simulation-verified matched pairs of buggy and correct Verilog modules, revealing that LLM hardware reviewers exhibit a consistent asymmetry: they rarely miss real bugs but routinely reject correct RTL, while synthetic mutants hide part of this problem.
